    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    trace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    converted_at REAL NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_run ON receipts(run_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_cache_key ON refinement_log(cache_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_refinement_session ON refinement_log(session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_traces_structure ON traces(structure_signature)

CREATE TABLE provenance_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE receipts (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp REAL NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    verify_result INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verify_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    model_id TEXT, effect_class TEXT, reversibility TEXT, reversal_json TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id)
)

CREATE TABLE refinement_log (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    inserted_at REAL NOT NULL
, cache_key TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

CREATE TABLE traces (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
    violations_json TEXT NOT NULL
, run_id TEXT, run_status TEXT, failed_step_id TEXT, total_duration_ms REAL, structure_signature TEXT)
